name: Flashy Finesse (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Weapon Finesse, Cha 15.

Benefit(s): You can choose to add your Charisma modifier rather than Dexterity modifier to attack rolls on attacks which add your Charisma modifier to their damage.
